name: Tolerance Technology Jiangsu Co. Ltd.
summary: Tolerance Technology (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sale of metal components for core semiconductor equipment such as thin film deposition and etching equipment in China. It offers key semiconductor process components, such as gas equalization ring, gas equalization plate, gas distribution disk, cavity, Lining, electrostatic chuck substrate, heater, cold dishes, and multi-tube heating reflector; semiconductor process component products, such as cooling process components, electrostatic chuck mounting base, air duct seat, chamber cover plate, crystal furnace; semiconductor structural components, such as flange, signal box housing, cover plate, general structural components; laser equipment components, includes laser cavity, laser equipment cooling process components; and system assembly products and gas piping products, such as module products, and gas piping products. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Qidong, China.
